name: Opuntia
description: Prickly pear cactus: oval pads budding from the shoulders of one another, each dotted all over with pale areoles.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { width: 40%; height: 54%; top: 20%; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, var(--color1) 0 28%, transparent 28%) 0 0 / 33.3% 25%, @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transform: rotate(@rn(-12, 12, 3)deg); transform: rotate(@rn(-12, 12, 3)deg); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -24%; bottom: 84%; width: 86%; height: 84%; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, var(--color1) 0 28%, transparent 28%) 0 0 / 33.3% 25%, @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); transform-origin: 50% 100%; -webkit-transform: rotate(-34deg); transform: rotate(-34deg); opacity: @p(0, 1, 1); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 38%; bottom: 82%; width: 80%; height: 80%; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, var(--color1) 0 28%, transparent 28%) 0 0 / 33.3% 25%, @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); transform-origin: 50% 100%; -webkit-transform: rotate(30deg); transform: rotate(30deg); opacity: @p(0, 1, 1); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
